data.name: Magic Isle Simulator
data.detailed_description:
A MAGICAL TRADING ADVENTURE AWAITS YOU!

Welcome to a secret and fantastical wizard-only town where wands are used not just for casting spells, but also for soaring through the sky! Take over the magic shop inherited from your grandfather and dive into a truly enchanting trading experience. Whether alone or with friends in online co-op for up to 4 players, grow your shop's reputation and become an indispensable part of this magical world.

STRONGER TOGETHER: 4-PLAYER CO-OP EXPERIENCE

Running a magic shop is harder than it looks, so gather your team! With co-op mode supporting up to 4 players, divide the tasks:

  • One of you grows magical herbs in the greenhouse and brews potions,

  • Another can craft the finest wands in the workshop — used both for casting spells and flying.

  • A third friend stands at the register, keeping customers happy with gold, silver, and bronze calculations,

  • And the fourth can clean up, arrange the displays, and chase sneaky thieves!

Communicate, divide the work, and multiply your profits together!

CRAFT, SELL, AND GROW YOUR SHOP

  • Rich Inventory: Offer your customers ancient spell books, flying broomsticks, flight wands, mystic jewelry, prophecy orbs, and magical candles.

  • Become a Master Craftsman: Use your potion-brewing and line-tracing skills to brew fresh potions and craft unique wands.

  • Upgrade and Customize: Use your earnings to add more counters, expand your greenhouse, and grow your display cases. Unlock rarer products with high-level wizard licenses.

DANGERS AND A DYNAMIC WORLD

  • Risk and Reward: Catch thieves sneaking into your shop in time. Be prepared for unexpected explosions and disasters caused by high-profit “cursed items.”

  • A Living Town: Life never stops in this magical town. Seasonal changes, day-night cycles, and market festivals shift customer demand. Seize opportunities by meeting the increased potion demand in winter.

CHOOSE YOUR SIDE: THE STRUGGLE OF SECRET SOCIETIES

You'll find yourself caught in the cold war between the authoritarian “Round Table” — who want to keep magic hidden from ordinary people — and the “Watchers”, who aim to share magic with everyone.

  • Complete the Watchers' special orders to earn rare rewards,

  • Or follow the Round Table's rules to get rent discounts.

But tread carefully! The consequences of your choices are heavy; angering the wrong side can lead to midnight raids or crippling taxes on your shop.

data.short_description: In a fantastical wizard town where sorcerers soar on wands, manage your own magic shop in co-op for up to 4 players! Brew potions together, craft flight wands, and grow your shop. Chase thieves, balance the power of secret societies, and build the most magnificent shop of all.

English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Russian, Turkish
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050 / RX 570 (4GB+ of VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • Additional Notes: LOW Quality / 60FPS / 1920x1080.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu >= 20.04, Arch or similar
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (8th gen or higher) or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Graphics: Radeon RX 560 or GeForce GTX 1050
